# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## What This Repo Is

**al-folio** — a Jekyll 4.x static site template for academics. Content is authored in Markdown/BibTeX/YAML, rendered by Jekyll, and deployed to GitHub Pages via the `gh-pages` branch (auto-generated by CI; never edit it directly). The `main` branch is the source of truth.

## Essential Commands

```bash
# Start dev server (recommended — Docker ensures parity with CI)
docker compose pull && docker compose up
# → http://localhost:8080

# Rebuild after changing Gemfile or Dockerfile
docker compose up --build

# Format all files before committing (CI will reject unformatted code)
npx prettier . --write
# First time only: npm install --save-dev prettier @shopify/prettier-plugin-liquid
```

## Architecture Overview

### Content Model

| Directory / File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `_config.yml` | Primary config: site identity, `url`/`baseurl`, feature flags, analytics |
| `_data/` | Structured YAML data: `socials.yml`, `cv.yml`, `coauthors.yml`, `venues.yml`, `repositories.yml`, `citations.yml` |
| `_pages/` | Static pages (About, Blog, CV, Publications, Projects, Teaching, etc.) |
| `_posts/` | Blog posts — must be named `YYYY-MM-DD-title.md` |
| `_projects/` | Project showcase entries |
| `_news/` | News/announcement snippets shown on the home page |
| `_teachings/` | Course/teaching pages |
| `_bibliography/papers.bib` | BibTeX publications (rendered by `jekyll-scholar`) |
| `_sass/` | SCSS stylesheets; theme colors live in `_themes.scss` and variables in `_variables.scss` |
| `_includes/` | Reusable Liquid components (header, footer, CV section renderers, repository cards, etc.) |
| `_layouts/` | Page layouts (about.liquid, post.liquid, bib.liquid, cv.liquid, distill.liquid, …) |
| `_scripts/` | JavaScript |
| `assets/` | Images (`img/`), PDFs (`pdf/`), JSON resumes (`json/`), fonts, third-party libs |

### CV Formats

The site supports two CV formats simultaneously:
- **RenderCV** — `_data/cv.yml` + `assets/rendercv/` (auto-generates PDF via CI)
- **JSONResume** — `assets/json/resume.json`

`_pages/cv.md` frontmatter `cv_format:` switches between them (`rendercv` or `jsonresume`).

### Rendering Pipeline

1. Jekyll processes Liquid templates + Markdown → static HTML in `_site/`
2. GitHub Actions (`deploy.yml`) runs `bundle exec jekyll build` with `JEKYLL_ENV=production`, then PurgeCSS, and commits the result to `gh-pages`
3. Deployment takes ~4–5 minutes after pushing to `main`

## Critical Configuration Rules

`url` and `baseurl` in `_config.yml` **must be set together**:

```yaml
# Personal site (username.github.io)
url: https://username.github.io
baseurl:                          # leave empty, but keep the key

# Project site (username.github.io/repo-name)
url: https://username.github.io
baseurl: /repo-name
```

Getting these wrong causes CSS/JS to 404.

## Commit Message Format

```
<type>: <subject>
```

Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `config`, `chore`

## Pre-Commit Checklist

1. `npx prettier . --write` — CI fails on formatting issues
2. `docker compose up --build` — verify the site builds and renders at http://localhost:8080

## Common Pitfalls

- **YAML special characters** — quote values containing `:`, `&`, `#`: `title: "My: Site"`
- **Related posts error** ("Zero vectors cannot be normalized") — post has no meaningful content; set `related_posts: false` in frontmatter
- **Port in use** — `docker compose down` frees port 8080
- **gh-pages branch** — never edit; it's auto-generated
- **`_site/` directory** — never commit; it's gitignored build output
